dimensions.method: Manual orthogonal schematic of visible adjacency and labels; no scale bar, measured reference, perspective calibration or site survey was available.
dimensions.confidence: No defensible metric accuracy bound; distances are demo-model distances only.

coordinate_frame.origin: South-west corner of schematic central block
coordinate_frame.north: Not georeferenced. Photo orientation arrows vary with the posted-plan viewing direction.
coordinate_frame.alignment: Floors share an illustrative XY frame. Side-wing registration and correspondence of stair stops are inferred.

notes: Floor-3 and floor-4 room categories and broad service-core adjacency are visible in photos. Absolute coordinates, room sizes, door widths, heights and wing registration are inferred.
The source plans are partial and differently rotated. The combined model is a deliberately simplified central block plus side office wing, not a complete or rectified whole-building trace.
The photos show lift and stair symbols. Their modeled continuity across all five floors and accessibility are demo assumptions, not verified on site.
Ground-floor reception is mentioned in the plan legend; its layout and entrance are synthetic. Floors 1 and 2 are wholly synthetic at the user's request.
Atrium/void regions are omitted from walkable spaces. Terrace geometry is modeled only where recognizable in the chosen upper-floor view.
No room numbers are legible: refs such as 3.01 are generated demo labels, not observed venue signage.
Furniture, coffee machines and movable equipment are illustrative additions. A visible kitchen label does not establish exact furniture inventory or placement.
Use for software demonstration only: not surveyed, not verified accessibility guidance and not an evacuation plan. Follow venue signage for actual movement.

movable_assets.purpose: Illustrative furniture move; not observed live tracking.
Illustrative equipment move within one valid space.

walk_path_basis: Illustrative floor-4 kitchen-to-stairs walk; hand-placed inside modeled spaces. Not measured pedestrian tracking. No vertical teleport animation.
